docs.description:
Triggers an action — submits forms, confirms decisions, performs commands. Not for navigation (use Link), toggling (use Switch), or selecting options (use Checkbox/Radio).

Variants (96):
• size — xs (28px) | sm (36px) | md (44px, default) | lg (48px)
• prio — primary | secondary | tertiary
• state — default | hover | pressed | disabled
• danger — false | true  (destructive/irreversible actions: delete, remove, revoke)

Focus is not a variant — apply the shared effect style shadow/focus/default (or shadow/focus/danger on danger buttons) to the current state on :focus-visible.

Sizing: sm renders below the 44px WCAG touch target — pad the hit area in code. xs is reserved for ultra-dense contexts where the row or toolbar itself is the target.

Labels: write as actions — "Save changes" not "OK", "Delete project" not "Yes". 1–3 words. Leading icon reinforces; trailing icon indicates direction; icon-only requires aria-label.

Rules: one primary per view. Danger is for destructive actions only — never for Cancel or Close. Never place two primary buttons side by side. Tertiary should not stand alone as the sole action.
figmaIssues: Description says 96 variants; the set has 108.
Axis `size`: description lists [xs, sm, md, lg], set has [md, sm, xl].
Axis `state`: description lists [default, hover, pressed, disabled], set has [default, hover, pressed, disabled, focus, loading].

rules.reason: The closest stock control on each platform. MUI Button and Flutter FilledButton both take a variant, a size and a disabled state and supply focus, ripple and accessibility; the recipe restyles them. Flip to null (bespoke) if the recipe cannot express what SOLAR draws.
The docs-to-code design spec names the public prop `variant`, as MUI and most React libraries do; `prio` is the Figma property name.
